prompt.text: Locked camera, one continuous shot. Her hand at the shoe draws the yellow card out of the window and carries it low over the felt, yellow side up, to its place. She lays it flat there, yellow side up. Then her open hand glides back low over the felt, palm down, to the shoe and takes the next card. The other hand rests on the felt. Only one card moves; its back is yellow and its face is blue. The next card waits plain yellow in the shoe's window.
